cards.example_en: I ate an apple after lunch at school.
cards.example_zh: 我在学校午饭后吃了一个苹果。

cards.example_en: We bake bread together on Sunday mornings at home.
cards.example_zh: 周日早上，我们在家一起烤面包。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：面包店
cards.example_en: I buy fresh bread from the bakery every morning.
cards.example_zh: 我每天早上从面包店买新鲜面包。

cards.example_en: I packed a banana for the long walk to school.
cards.example_zh: 我为走去学校的那一段长路带了一根香蕉。

cards.example_en: We ate barbecue in the garden on Saturday evening.
cards.example_zh: 星期六晚上，我们在花园里吃了烧烤。

cards.example_en: Honesty is the basis of a strong friendship.
cards.example_zh: 诚实是一份牢固友谊的基础。

cards.example_en: Children bathe before bed when they play in the mud.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们在泥地里玩过之后，睡觉前会洗澡。

cards.example_en: We had beef and rice for Sunday dinner.
cards.example_zh: 星期天晚饭我们吃了牛肉和米饭。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：长椅子
cards.example_en: Grandma sat on a bench in the sunny park.
cards.example_zh: 奶奶坐在阳光明媚的公园长椅上。

cards.example_en: She reads a page of the Bible before bed.
cards.example_zh: 她睡觉前会读一页《圣经》。

cards.example_en: He dipped a biscuit into his warm milk.
cards.example_zh: 他把饼干蘸进了温热的牛奶里。

cards.example_en: Boil the eggs for eight minutes before breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 早饭前把鸡蛋煮八分钟。

cards.example_en: I filled a bottle with cold water for the match.
cards.example_zh: 我灌了一瓶冷水，准备比赛时喝。

cards.example_en: Seaweed stuck to the bottom of the old boat.
cards.example_zh: 海草粘在那艘旧船的底面上。
